# CLI reference

```text
A tmux-backed command center for running coding agents side by side.

Run `deaner` with no arguments to open the sidebar and terminal frame.

Usage: deaner [COMMAND]

Commands:
  sidebar        Run the sidebar in the current terminal (the frame runs this for you)
  add            Add repos or folders to the sidebar
  forget         Forget a repo; its sessions keep running and files are untouched
  new            Create a worktree for BRANCH in REPO and start a session for it
  open           Start (or unpark) a workspace and switch to it
  tab            Add a tab to a workspace, e.g. `deaner tab api claude` or `deaner tab api logs -- tail -f app.log`
  archive        Remove a worktree and kill its session
  ls             List workspaces, tabs and agent states
  send           Type a message into another agent's tab and press Enter
  whoami         Print this pane's address, for other agents to `deaner send` to
  save           Snapshot all workspaces now
  park           Save a workspace and stop its session; open it again to bring it back
  restore        Rebuild workspaces from the latest snapshot
  shutdown       Done for the day: save everything, then stop all sessions
  install-hooks  Install deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings
  keys           Show keybindings
  config         Show where config and state live, or print the default config
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## deaner sidebar

```text
Run the sidebar in the current terminal (the frame runs this for you)

Usage: deaner sidebar [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --standalone
          Allow `q` to quit (implied outside the frame)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## deaner tab

```text
Add a tab to a workspace, e.g. `deaner tab api claude` or `deaner tab api logs -- tail -f app.log`

Usage: deaner tab <TARGET> <NAME> [-- <COMMAND>...]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          

  <NAME>
          

  [COMMAND]...
          Command to run in the tab (defaults to the agent of the same name, or a shell)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## deaner archive

```text
Remove a worktree and kill its session

Usage: deaner archive [OPTIONS] <TARGET>

Arguments:
  <TARGET>
          

Options:
      --force
          Remove even with uncommitted changes

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## deaner send

```text
Type a message into another agent's tab and press Enter

Usage: deaner send [OPTIONS] <ADDR> <TEXT>...

Arguments:
  <ADDR>
          `<session>` or `<session>:<tab>` (see `deaner ls`)

  <TEXT>...
          

Options:
      --no-enter
          Type the text without pressing Enter

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## deaner install-hooks

```text
Install deaner's status hooks into an agent's settings

Usage: deaner install-hooks [OPTIONS] [AGENT]

Arguments:
  [AGENT]
          [default: claude]

Options:
      --uninstall
          Remove deaner's hooks instead

      --settings <SETTINGS>
          Settings file (default: ~/.claude/settings.json)

      --command <COMMAND>
          How hooks should invoke deaner
          
          [default: deaner]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
